hooks.command: jq -r '.prompt // ""' | grep -q '/develop' && { count=$(find docs/design/ -name '*.md' 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$count" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"⚠️ GATE VIOLATION: Ingen design-dokumenter funnet i docs/design/. Kjør /design først og få godkjenning før du starter utvikling."}}'; fi; } || true

jq -r 'select(.tool_input.command | test("test")) | "[" + (now | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) + "] Command: " + .tool_input.command + "
Output: " + (.tool_response.stdout // "no output") + "
Exit: " + (.tool_response.exitCode // 0 | tostring) + "
---"' >> .dsf/logs/test-output.log 2>/dev/null || true
